entries.ed78d7c7f2582339: As a pioneer among rubber and plastic product manufacturers, it cites as its strength meeting customer needs through the development of new technologies and new products. Centered on power transmission belts, it has three businesses (automotive parts, industrial materials and high-performance elastomers) and new businesses such as medical devices and electronic materials, and operates globally through production and sales bases in Japan and overseas. It identifies the decline in sales of accessory drive power transmission belts for new vehicles, associated with the electrification of automobiles, as its greatest risk, and while focusing on the new businesses of medical devices, healthcare devices and electronic materials, it responds by expanding its share of belts for the replacement market for internal combustion engine vehicles and developing products for EVs.
